# Wanderlog

> > Wanderlog is a travel planning platform featuring curated guides to the best restaurants, cafes, and dining experiences in destinations worldwide.

The site provides comprehensive, location-specific dining guides with curated lists of top-rated establishments. Wanderlog helps travelers discover the best coffee shops, sushi restaurants, and other culinary destinations, with a focus on Ukraine and other global locations.

## Key Topics

- Wanderlog
- Travel planning
- Restaurant guides
- Coffee shops and cafes
- Kiev Oblast

- Destination dining
